title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Paragraph 3 of Article 79 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, based on circumstances encountered in judicial practice, discussed the question of whether the provision in Article 79, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Procedure Law concerning the permissibility of arrest where a violation of the provisions on release on bail pending investigation or trial or residential surveillance is serious applies to criminal suspects or defendants who may be sentenced to punishment less than imprisonment, and interprets as follows:
Pursuant to the provisions of Article 79, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Procedure Law, a criminal suspect or defendant who is released on bail pending investigation or trial or placed under residential surveillance, who may be sentenced to punishment less than imprisonment, and who violates the provisions on release on bail pending investigation or trial or residential surveillance, thereby seriously affecting the normal conduct of litigation proceedings, may be arrested.
This is hereby announced.
